set.body: Child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF per T1. Acceptance: the extractor emits SampledFrameSet-shaped frames per part by exact presentation ordinal (ffmpeg select on streaming decode, not -ss) plus envelopes; an executed synthetic witness links each emitted frame's ordinal and PTS to the PacketIndex, with selection and any transformation recorded; the bench sidecar is documented LEGACY and the frozen Sherlock-dev AV arm is untouched. Depends on AC4-S1.
